name: 60624 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60624 (Chicago) has 171 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60624 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60624 (Chicago) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 45 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
